content.short: Stratium offers structured products on Hyperliquid including volatility perps and asset baskets.
content.description: Stratium is a HIP-3 platform on Hyperliquid for trading structured markets. Every Hyperliquid perp is tradeable through its interface today, covering BTC, ETH, HYPE and more than a hundred markets, with native HIP-3 instruments carrying structured payoffs arriving alongside them. Binary, recurring and multi-outcome markets built on HIP-4 are live on mainnet. Stakers deposit HYPE for srHYPE and receive 20 percent of venue fees, and srHYPE stays liquid for use elsewhere in DeFi. A ticket-based reward system funded from real venue fees pays out on-chain.
content.meta: Volatility perpetuals and asset baskets, putting options-desk exposure within reach.
